instruction: Who is the most followed artist I follow on Spotify?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes may occur, so the only state-changing step is task completion. The followed-artist listing is modeled as a single show_following_artists action whose extra (non-API) artist parameter stands for the artist selected from the response (max follower_count); at runtime the agent must iterate page_index until results are exhausted (or use a large page_limit) before picking the maximum, which is why the reference solution has more raw calls than the plan. The answer passed to supervisor.complete_task is the artist's name. supervisor-complete-task is forced last via (not (task-completed)) in every other action.
